content.text: The summer school began in 2009 with six students, one borrowed boatshed and a dinghy that took the whole summer to finish. It still sails from North Quay every Saturday.
Since then more than two thousand people have learned to build and sail with us. Some came back as mentors. A few now run boatyards of their own.
We're still a small charity, run by the people who teach here. Every fee goes back into the boats, the tools and the bursaries that keep places open to anyone who wants one.
